HEADTEACHER’S WELCOME
Welcome to Beatrix Potter – a thriving school where children flourish and succeed. Our school is renowned for our warm community. Our teaching is exciting and active. There is a wealth of expertise, experience and skill amongst the teaching staff who are known for their dedication and deep care of the children. Our families are both inclusive and welcoming, developing lasting friendships through their Beatrix Potter connection. Best of all, our children are interested, outward looking, kind, motivated and extremely well behaved.
